Metro Manila traffic is no longer just an inconvenience. It is a national crisis. 🚦

In his latest “Babe’s Eye View”, Philippine Ambassador to the US Jose Manuel “Babe” Romualdez asks a tough question: What is the long-term cost of doing nothing?

Looking at how countries like Indonesia tackled over-centralization, he argues that bold, long-term decisions may be the only way forward. Is it time for the Philippines to consider a drastic move too?

Read: https://t.co/ouaxGsxLy9
